run_dataset_cleaning_pipeline: run the script to load, shuffle, deduplicate, filter English prompts, and push the cleaned dataset to the Hugging Face Hub
load_and_shuffle_dataset: load the fal/imgsys-results dataset from the Hugging Face Hub and shuffle its rows
deduplicate_prompts: remove duplicate entries based on the prompt column in the dataset
filter_english_prompts: detect the language of each prompt using fast_langdetect and keep only English entries
push_cleaned_dataset_to_hub: convert the cleaned prompts to a Hugging Face Dataset and push it to the Hub
